item.title: House Overwhelmingly Shields Its Own from Sexual Misconduct Disclosures
item.description: Congress voted 357-65 to bury House sexual misconduct transparency, shielding decades of Ethics Committee files on harassment allegations from public view—protecting predators or victims?

item.title: Big Banks’ Yield War: Why They’re Fighting Tooth and Nail to Block 5%+ Returns on Your Money
item.description: Banks are lobbying to ban stablecoin yields offering 4-5%+ returns, protecting their near-zero savings rates—Eric Trump calls it anti-American as the CLARITY Act stalls. Who wins: Wall Street or everyday savers?

item.title: Blue Bell’s Lone Star Scoop Tour
item.description: Blue Bell’s Lone Star Scoop Tour is traveling across Texas this spring, handing out free ice cream, frozen treats, and merchandise as a thank-you to the communities that have supported the company for more than a century.

item.title: Oil Prices Surge as Iran War Disrupts Strait of Hormuz Traffic
item.description: Global oil prices surged and then fluctuated sharply as conflict involving Iran disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a vital route for the world’s oil supply.

item.title: Texas A&M’s $200 Million Space Institute
item.description: Texas A&M is opening a $200 million Space Institute next to NASA’s Johnson Space Center that will feature the world’s largest indoor Moon and Mars simulation landscapes for research and astronaut training.

item.title: FAA Selects Eight Projects to Test eVTOL [VIDEO]
item.description: The FAA has selected eight pilot projects nationwide—including one in Texas—to test electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft (eVTOLs) that could transform transportation, cargo delivery, and emergency services.

item.title: Austin County Cruisers 22nd Classic Car Stampede
item.description: A preview of the Austin County Cruisers’ 22nd Classic Car Stampede in historic downtown Bellville featuring classic vehicles, family-friendly activities, and community support.
